leads.species: Ficus macrophylla (Palazzo Pantelleria, Piazza Giovanni Meli)
leads.reason: MASAF register, girth 1010cm, height 17m, 517m from pal_001 (Piazza Marina). A genuinely strong candidate in the city-centre cluster, not chosen this pass only because Villa Malfitano and Villa Tasca's figs were stronger on both size and available second-sourcing within the 40-minute window. Worth a first look on any future Palermo top-up.

MASAF register, girth 1000cm, height 20m, 602m from pal_004. Different fig species (Ficus virens/Fico bianco rather than macrophylla) which would add species variety to a page that is currently all Ficus macrophylla among its figs. UPDATE (2026-08-17 verify pass): searched for a genuine second source and found none within the time window (no monumentaltrees.com entry located, no dedicated local page beyond the register itself); the register/existence side is solid but the two-independent-sources bar is not yet cleared. Not a known problem, just unproven so far.
MASAF register, girth 820cm, 332m from pal_006 (Villa Trabia). Not researched this pass; no known issue.

MASAF register, girth 680cm, only 188m from the already-published pal_006 (Villa Trabia fig, girth 480cm per that entry's own notes). Not a coordinate-duplicate (188m is outside the 80m radius, and pal_006's own story already says 'roughly twenty other fig trees share the grounds' at Villa Trabia), but shipping this one too would mean two very similar Villa Trabia fig entries on one page; left as a lead rather than a second Villa Trabia tree this pass, especially since it is actually the larger-girth specimen and could eventually replace or supplement pal_006 rather than simply duplicate it. Worth a dedicated look at which of the two Villa Trabia figs (480cm vs 680cm) is the better entry, or whether both could work as one combined story.

MASAF register, girth 560cm, height 30m, 208m from pal_003 (Orto Botanico fig). A giant pecan inside the same botanical garden already on the page; would add non-fig species variety. Not researched this pass.

MASAF register, girth 300cm, 140m from pal_003. A third dragon tree location (after pal_004 Villa Malfitano and pal_005 Palazzina Cinese); not chosen this pass to avoid a third near-identical dragon-tree entry, not for any factual problem.

MASAF register, girth 660cm, at a sanctuary (Santuario di Santa Maria di Gesu') about 4km from the centre and roughly 3.1-3.3km from the nearest published Palermo tree. Different species (olive) than anything currently on the page; not researched this pass for access/distance reasons, not a known problem.

leads.sheet_id: 23/G273/PA/19 (and 22/G273/PA/19, a different species at the same coordinates)
leads.species: Nolina longifolia / Nolina gracilis (Vivai Lo Porto, x2)
leads.reason: Large-girth register entries, but not trees in the sense this site collects (woody monocots/succulents); left out on species-fit grounds. Note: this pass DID verify and deliver the Yucca gigantea at Villa Malfitano (12/G273/PA/19, now pal_013) and the Dracaena draco at Vivai Lo Porto (24/G273/PA/19, now pal_014) despite the same monocot caveat, on the brief's explicit instruction to resolve that cluster and because both clear the 'visually spectacular' bar; the Nolina pair was not, for lack of time, and remains an open judgement call rather than a rejection.

leads.species: Platanus acerifolia / Platano comune (Via Piano dell'Ucciardone)
leads.reason: MASAF/Sicilia register, girth 420cm, height 28m. A dedicated page exists at lasiciliainrete.it ('Platano dell'Ucciardone') but on the pattern seen elsewhere on that domain this pass (see the Villa Trabia Araucaria and Villa Malfitano Yucca entries) it appears to just republish the same national-decree row rather than add independent facts, so it likely does not clear the two-independent-sources bar on its own; not fetched and checked directly this pass for time. Worth a direct look plus a search for the Ucciardone prison neighbourhood's own history (the tree stands by Palermo's Ucciardone prison), which might supply real context.

MASAF/Sicilia register, girth 410cm, height 10m. Giardino Inglese (Piersanti Mattarella Park) is well documented as a public 1851 exotic-plant garden (English Wikipedia), which is good general context but not a source naming this specific tree; searched for a dedicated second source this pass (cefalunews.org, venipedia.it, lasiciliainrete.it, monumentaltrees.com) without success in the time available. venipedia.it 403s automated fetches; cefalunews.org's automated summary garbled the register's girth-cm column into a fake 'years' age for every tree in it (a live example of the units/fields trap BRIEF_RESEARCH.md warns about, do not trust that page's numbers for anything). Worth a browser-session look at monumentaltrees.com's Giardino Inglese pages, which do exist for at least one other tree there (a Ficus macrophylla, https://www.monumentaltrees.com/en/ita/sicily/palermo/4318_giardinoinglese/).
